title: Publications
description: A rigorous archive of peer-reviewed research, academic theses, and technical papers dissecting migration dynamics, economic complexity, and spatial statistics.
seoDescription: Read my academic research papers and articles on economics, migration, and data science.

items.title: Masters Thesis: Migration Dynamics in Brazil
items.excerpt: A comprehensive decoding of human movement. My Master's thesis investigates the complex socioeconomic drivers of migration in Brazil, utilizing advanced spatial datasets and economic indicators.

items.title: Knowledge Spillovers Across Micro-Regions of Brazil
items.excerpt: Probing the spatiality of innovation. This research utilizes Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) to map the impact of education and economic complexity on regional growth.

items.title: Export complexity, industrial complexity and regional economic growth in Brazil
items.excerpt: Drivers of regional growth. A comparative analysis of economic complexity metrics (ECI) derived from export and employment data to uncover hidden patterns in the Brazilian industrial landscape.

items.title: Bachelor Thesis: Human Capital, Knowledge Spillovers, and Economic Complexity
items.excerpt: Foundations of complexity. My Bachelor's thesis explores the interplay between human capital and knowledge diffusion as primary catalysts for regional economic transformation.

items.title: Benchmarking Spatial Statistics
items.excerpt: Pushing the limits of spatial computation. A rigorous technical benchmark of spatial statistics algorithms across diverse hardware architectures, focusing on performance and code optimization.

items.title: Socioeconomic Observatory of Santa Catarina
items.excerpt: Monitoring regional development. A specialized dashboard designed to analyze and forecast socioeconomic trends in Santa Catarina, providing actionable insights for development planning.
